title: 第19章 你想要家我给你一个家第20章 想要我跪除非你死
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
第19章你想要家，我给你一个家他的样子看起来好像有点委屈，又好像很怕失去她似的。
唐凝真怕自己发烧烧糊涂了，竟然越来越自作多情了。
她不想被误会，“纪瑾修，你说什么呢？我没这意思。”
纪瑾修促狭的眸子眯了眯，“那是什么意思？”
“你看我们现在只是合作婚姻，传家玉佩这么宝贵的东西，我怕弄丢了，当然要留给你保管了。”唐凝实话实说，又指了指那些股权文件，
“还有这些，都太贵重了。”
到时候，如果纪瑾修找到喜欢的人了。
再让她把这些东西吐回去，岂不是太难受了？
还不如不曾拥有。
“你想的只是这些？”纪瑾修像是在确认什么，脸色有所缓和。
唐凝不知道他心里想的，如实点点头，“没错，不然你以为是什么？”
得到验证，纪瑾修才知道误会她了，刚才的怒意顿时消散了一大半。
冷峻的眉眼又再变得温润，与往常无异。
他说：“既然是爷爷给你这个孙媳妇的，你就收下。”
‘孙媳妇’三个字，听得唐凝心跳加速，她脸红了红。
罢了，收就收吧。
唐凝嘀咕着，“那好吧，以后可别找我要回去。”
“你说什么？”纪瑾修没听清。
唐凝抿唇摇摇头，“没什么。”
“倒是和从前一样气人了。”纪瑾修鼻息淡淡叹出口气。

唐凝听到了，拧眉，奇怪地看他。
只见纪瑾修又拿出一份文件，“我也有礼物要送你。”
怎么都要送她文件？
一份接一份的。
唐凝疑惑看着他。
纪瑾修声音清洌：“这套别墅已经过户到你名下，现在只属于你一个人的。”
“什么？”唐凝险些以为听错了。
纪瑾修眼底笑意温润，“不是想要个属于自己的家？现在你有了。”
唐凝怔住。
好半天，才找回声音，“你，怎么知道？”
她声音很轻，仔细听，能听到声音带着轻微的颤抖。
十八岁那年。
唐凝许下生日愿望：大学毕业后的第一个生日，希望有个属于自己的家。
她之前住的那套公寓，是爷爷买给她方便上大学住。
前阵子卖了后，她名下已无房产。
唐凝今年二十二有三，今天正是大学毕业的第一个生日。
纪瑾修温柔的目光凝在她脸上，嘴角弧度宠溺神秘，“没什么是我不知道的。”
唐凝嘴角抽动，心里说不出的滋味。
曾经，她以为会是纪寒，给一个属于她的家。
没想到，竟然是他。

那个曾经与她针锋相对，总是对她板着个脸的纪瑾修。
想想，可能这就是纪瑾修和纪寒的区别。
纪瑾修一向做事成熟稳重，婚后送她一个家，属于责任所在。
对纪瑾修而言，兴许和她领证结婚，是最不稳重的一件事了。
唐凝红了眼，眼眸被湿润的水雾模糊，差点要掉下眼泪。
content_en:
Chapter 19 You want a home, I'll give you a home. He looked a little aggrieved, and as if he was afraid of losing her.
Tang Ning was really afraid that she had a fever and was confused, and she was becoming more and more sentimental.
She didn't want to be misunderstood, "Ji Jinxiu, what did you say? I didn't mean that."
Ji Jinxiu narrowed his eyes, "What does that mean?"
"You see, we are just in a cooperative marriage now. I'm afraid of losing such a precious heirloom jade pendant, so of course I have to leave it to you for safekeeping." Tang Ning told the truth and pointed to the equity documents.
"And these are too expensive."
By then, if Ji Jinxiu finds someone he likes.
Wouldn't it be too uncomfortable to ask her to vomit these things back again?
It's better not to have it.
"That's all you think about?" Ji Jinxiu seemed to be confirming something, his expression softened.
Tang Ning didn't know what he was thinking, so she nodded truthfully, "Yes, otherwise what did you think it was?"
After receiving the verification, Ji Jinxiu realized that he had misunderstood her, and most of the anger just now dissipated.
The stern eyebrows became gentle again, just like before.
He said: "Since grandpa gave it to you, my granddaughter-in-law, you should accept it."
The words 'granddaughter-in-law' made Tang Ning's heart beat faster and she blushed.
That’s all, just accept it.
Tang Ning muttered, "Okay then, don't ask me to go back in the future."
"What did you say?" Ji Jinxiu didn't hear clearly.
Tang Ning pursed her lips and shook her head, "It's nothing."
"It's just as annoying as before." Ji Jinxiu sighed lightly.
Tang Ning heard this and frowned, looking at him strangely.
Ji Jinxiu took out another document and said, "I also have a gift for you."
Why do you have to send her documents?
One piece after another.
Tang Ning looked at him doubtfully.
Ji Jinxiu's voice was clear: "This villa has been transferred to your name, and now it belongs to you alone."
"What?" Tang Ning almost thought she heard wrongly.
Ji Jinxiu had a warm smile in his eyes, "Don't you want a home of your own? Now you have one."
Tang Ning was stunned.
It took a long time before I found my voice, "How did you know?"
Her voice was very soft, and if you listened carefully, you could hear a slight tremor in her voice.
When I was eighteen years old.
Tang Ning made a birthday wish: on her first birthday after graduating from college, she hopes to have a home of her own.
The apartment she lived in before was bought by her grandfather for her to live in while attending college.
After selling it a while ago, she no longer has any real estate in her name.
Tang Ning is twenty-two this year, and today is her first birthday after graduating from college.
Ji Jinxiu's gentle eyes were fixed on her face, and the corners of his mouth curved in a loving and mysterious way, "There's nothing I don't know."
The corners of Tang Ning's mouth twitched, and she felt an indescribable feeling in her heart.
Once, she thought it would be Ji Han who would give her a home.
Unexpectedly, it was him.
Ji Jinxiu, who used to be tit-for-tat with her and always had a straight face towards her.
Thinking about it, maybe this is the difference between Ji Jinxiu and Ji Han.
Ji Jinxiu has always been mature and steady in doing things, so it is his responsibility to give her a home after marriage.
For Ji Jinxiu, getting married with her was probably the most unstable thing.
Tang Ning's eyes were red, her eyes were blurred by the moist mist, and she almost shed tears.
